ffxiv_plugin.title: FullParty in FFXIV
ffxiv_plugin.description: View your FullParty roster and check in party members directly from the game.
ffxiv_plugin.audience_title: Mainly for hosts and party leads
ffxiv_plugin.audience_description: The plugin currently focuses on helping organisers manage runs and coordinate their party.
ffxiv_plugin.requirement: You’ll need XIVLauncher with Dalamud enabled.

repository.title: Add the repository
repository.description: Open Dalamud Settings (/xlsettings), then Experimental → Custom Plugin Repositories. Paste this URL, click + and save.

install.title: Install FullParty
install.description: Open the Plugin Installer (/xlplugins), search for FullParty and choose Install.

connect.title: Connect your account
connect.description: Open the plugin and follow its sign-in instructions to connect your FullParty account in your browser. You can manage or revoke that connection below.

active_sessions.subtitle: Apps and plugins connected to your account.
active_sessions.empty_description: Connected apps and plugins will appear here.

revoke_modal.title: Revoke app session
revoke_modal.description: This will disconnect {name} from your FullParty account.
revoke_modal.warning: The app or plugin will need to be linked again before it can access your account.

notifications.discord_app_description: Connect the FullParty Discord app to receive supported Discord notifications and use group Discord features.
notifications.discord_app_connected_description: FullParty can send supported Discord notifications to this account.

notifications.group_updates_description: Invites, membership changes, and other important updates from your groups.
notifications.account_character_updates_description: Character verification, imports, claim flow updates, and account-related status changes.
notifications.system_notices_description: Critical maintenance and outage notices are always sent. This toggle only controls optional product updates, feature announcements, and project status news.

notifications.discord_link_token_expires: Share this token with the FullParty Discord bot. It expires {date}.
notifications.discord_link_token_active: A link token is active until {date}. Generate a new one if you need to see it again.
notifications.disconnect_discord_confirm: Disconnect Discord from your FullParty account? FullParty will stop using Discord for your account, but you still need to remove the app inside Discord if you want it fully gone.

disconnect_discord_modal.title: Disconnect Discord
disconnect_discord_modal.description: FullParty will stop using Discord for your account and turn off Discord notifications.
disconnect_discord_modal.warning: This does not remove the app from Discord. To fully remove it, open Discord settings, go to Authorized Apps, and remove FullParty.

discord_integration.title: Keep up with your runs in Discord
discord_integration.description: Connect the FullParty app to receive useful updates where you already chat with your party.

reminders.title: Run reminders
reminders.description: Get notified when a run is starting soon or starting now, with a link back to the run.

applications.title: Application and roster updates
applications.description: Keep track of application decisions and published roster or bench changes.

identity.title: Let the bot recognise you
identity.description: Link your FullParty identity and primary character so the bot can match you to your account.

discord_integration.difference_title: How is this different from Discord login?
discord_integration.login_description: This is a way to log into the FullParty website. It does not connect the FullParty app or enable Discord notifications.
discord_integration.app_description: This links your account to the FullParty bot for supported notifications and bot features. You can use it even if you sign in with email, Google or XIVAuth.
discord_integration.personal_connection: This is your personal connection. Group Discord servers are linked separately by group organisers.

steps.connect: Choose Connect Discord App to open Discord’s authorisation screen.
steps.authorize: Check that you are using the right Discord account, review the permissions and authorise FullParty.
steps.preferences: Open Notifications and choose which supported updates you want delivered through Discord.

discord_integration.token_description: If the FullParty bot asks for a link token, generate one here. Share it only with the FullParty bot; it expires and can only be used once.
discord_integration.disconnect_description: Disconnecting here stops the app connection and Discord notifications, but does not change your sign-in methods. To remove the app from Discord too, remove FullParty under Authorized Apps in Discord’s settings.

deletion_details.warning_description: Your FullParty account will be closed and you will be signed out immediately. You will no longer be able to sign in to this account.

account.title: Account details and access
account.description: Your account name and email are replaced with deleted-account details, and your profile picture is cleared. Website sessions and linked app or plugin access are revoked.

connections.title: Memberships and connections
connections.description: Your group memberships, social sign-in links, Discord app connection and notification inbox are removed.

characters.title: Characters are released
characters.description: Your characters are unlinked from your account. Their Primary, Verified and Claimed statuses are cleared.

runs.title: Active run commitments
runs.description: Active applications are withdrawn and your characters are removed from upcoming rosters. Affected group organisers are notified when assignments are cleared.

deletion_details.history_description: Past applications, run and attendance history, character records and audit logs are retained to preserve shared group records. Deleting your account does not erase every reference to your past participation.
deletion_details.external_accounts: This only closes your FullParty account. Your in-game FFXIV characters and accounts with Discord, Google or XIVAuth are not deleted.
deletion_details.confirmation_hint: You will be asked to confirm before anything is deleted.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.profile_visibility_description: Make your profile visible to other users
privacy.show_character_data_description: Display job levels and progression on your profile
privacy.delete_account_description: Once you delete your account, there is no going back. Please be certain.
privacy.delete_account_owner_blocked: Transfer or delete your owned groups before deleting your account.

delete_account_modal.title: Delete account
delete_account_modal.description: This will close your FullParty account and sign you out immediately.
delete_account_modal.warning: Sign-in access and live account state will be removed. Historical group and run records will be kept.
